summary: You sit bottom of the table on 79 points, so your GW4 claims process first if these players are still free when the window runs (waivers close 11 September). The clearest calls are swapping in Igor Jesus, now confirmed as Forest's first-choice striker over Chris Wood, for Marmoush, who faces genuine competition from Solanke on a winless Spurs side, and dropping Garner - who did not actually start last midweek as earlier reported and remains behind Hackney in Everton's pecking order - for Leeds' rock-solid Ampadu. Barcola and Doku are lower-confidence calls: Barcola is a confirmed bench option for his Liverpool debut rather than the starter his fee might suggest, and Doku's injury return is pegged for right around this gameweek, so trading him for Bournemouth's breakout find Rayan is more of a hedge than a certainty. The rest of the squad - Gvardiol, Milenkovic, Bijol (boosted by Rodon's injury), Collins, Munoz (now a confirmed starter at Forest despite his low model number), Schade, Tavernier, Strand Larsen and Haaland - are all confirmed starters performing at or above their model rating, so a fifth claim is not warranted this week.

claims.model: The model already rates Igor Jesus top of the free-agent forwards at next5 14.5 against Marmoush's 5.6 - agreeing with the model here, not overruling it; the fresh reporting on his nailed-on striker role and Marmoush's rotation risk only reinforces the gap.
